title: The best SEO trick was invisible
summary: How hidden white-on-white keywords once gamed Google, how Panda and Penguin ended it, and why AI answers changed the game again: being mentioned is not being cited.
sources: Google Search Central: spam policies (hidden text and links)
Google Search Central Blog: Finding more high-quality sites in search (Panda, 2011)
Google Search Central Blog: Another step to reward high-quality sites (Penguin, 2012)

scenes.voice: In the early two thousands, the best SEO trick was invisible.
scenes.headline: The best SEO trick was

scenes.voice: Sites hid keywords in white text, on a white page. Visitors saw nothing. But the crawler read every word, and ranked them for it.
scenes.hidden: cheap shoes best shoes buy shoes cheap shoes shoes sale best cheap shoes shoes shoes

scenes.voice: Then Google fought back. Updates like Panda, in twenty eleven, and Penguin, in twenty twelve, buried sites that gamed the system.
Today, more and more people skip the ten blue links. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini, and get one answer.
scenes.question: Best running shoe store near me?

scenes.voice: It's a new game. SEO gets you ranked. AEO and GEO get you into the answer.
Here's the catch. Mentioned is not cited. A mention comes from the model's memory. A citation means it used your page as the source.
Three quick checks. Let AI crawlers in. Tell machines who you are. And write answers worth quoting.
